description: Reconcile documentation and dependencies with the actual code: rewrite README.md to describe only real features and files, and fix requirements.txt so the quantum extras are installable while optional/heavy deps are clearly labelled. No source-module behavior changes. Independent of FEAT-002 (edits different files), but ordered first because the README should describe the repo as it will finally ship.
steps: Edit README.md: delete the entire 'Traffic chatbot (Featherless AI)' section and every reference to chatbot.py, FEATHERLESS_API_KEY, openai, and the empty pages/ directory. Verified by grep that none of these exist in code.

Edit README.md 'Project layout' table so it lists the files that actually exist: add live_app.py, config.py, logger.py, alerts.py, model_loader.py, video_detector.py, signal_controller.py, simple_tracker.py, speed_tracker.py, savings_predictor.py, live_intersection.py, and the accident_ncnn_model/ folder; keep app.py, traffic_network.py, quantum_optimizer.py, classical_baseline.py, emergency.py, events.py, environmental.py, requirements.txt.

Edit README.md to keep and accurately describe the genuinely-present features: two Streamlit apps (streamlit run app.py = NetworkX simulator + Folium map; streamlit run live_app.py = live YOLO detection on four videos), QUBO/QAOA optimizer in quantum_optimizer.py with classical simulated-annealing fallback, adaptive signal controller (signal_controller.py AdaptiveSignalController), emergency green corridor (emergency.py), accident detection via accident_ncnn_model/ + optional Twilio SMS (alerts.py), speed violations (speed_tracker.py / simple_tracker.py), JSON+CSV logging (logger.py). Keep the Windows PowerShell + venv setup block and the run commands.

Add to README.md a plain note that the QAOA path requires the qiskit 1.x stack (qiskit, qiskit-aer, qiskit-optimization, qiskit-algorithms); on qiskit 2.x it transparently falls back to classical annealing because qiskit.primitives.Sampler was removed. Add a short 'Secrets' subsection: copy .env.example to .env, fill Twilio creds, never commit .env.

Edit requirements.txt: add 'qiskit-algorithms>=0.3.0' to the optional quantum block; add a comment that QAOA needs the qiskit 1.x line and otherwise annealing fallback runs; group/label heavy & optional deps (torch/ultralytics, opencv-python, ncnn, twilio, qiskit*) as optional-for-full-features. Do NOT remove any dependency the code imports. There is no openai/chatbot dependency to remove (it was never present).
Do NOT modify quantum_optimizer.py or any other .py module in this feature.
acceptance_criteria: README.md still contains both 'streamlit run app.py' and 'streamlit run live_app.py'.
README.md Project layout table lists live_app.py, config.py, logger.py, alerts.py, video_detector.py, signal_controller.py, savings_predictor.py (at minimum) in addition to the original files.
requirements.txt contains a 'qiskit-algorithms' line within the quantum block and still lists ultralytics, opencv-python, twilio, python-dotenv.
No .py source module is modified by this feature.
verification: PowerShell: if (Select-String -Path README.md -Pattern 'chatbot|Featherless|FEATHERLESS|openai|pages/' -Quiet) { Write-Error 'stale refs remain' } else { 'README clean' }
PowerShell: Select-String -Path README.md -Pattern 'streamlit run app.py','streamlit run live_app.py' | Measure-Object  (expect 2+ matches)
python -c "import ultralytics, cv2, twilio, dotenv, networkx, folium, streamlit_folium, plotly; print('core deps import')"
